E212.title: Hydraulic pressure low
E212.article: Check reservoir sight glass and fill with HX Hydraulic Fluid 46; inspect/replace suction filter HX-F-4410; if persists, dealer pump inspection.

E305.title: Feeder house chain speed sensor fault
E305.article: Check sensor gap 1.5-2.5 mm (adjust with two M8 bolts); inspect harness near feeder house pivot; replace sensor HX-S-2270 if fault persists.

E410.title: Engine coolant temperature high
E410.article: Stop operation immediately; idle 3 minutes before shutdown; clean rotating radiator screen; check coolant when cool; do not resume until normal; contact dealer if it recurs.
